data.long_meaning: The name Sitesh is a Hindu name that is derived from Sanskrit language. It is a compound name composed of two words - 'Sita' and 'Ish', where Sita means fortune and Ish means Lord. The name Sitesh thus means 'Lord of Fortune'. It is a name that signifies wisdom, intelligence, and good luck. The name Sitesh carries the meaning “Lord of Fortune” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi, Marathi. Parents who choose Sitesh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of fortune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Hinduism, Sitesh is the name of Lord Vishnu, who is the preserver of the universe. The name is believed to bring prosperity, happiness, and good luck to the bearer.
data.etymology: Sitesh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Fortune.”
